name: @kotoba-lang/celler
description: kotoba reference implementation of celler (DID-addressed telephony — number-provisioning registry) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Custody-safe: only the owner's own DID↔E.164 bindings are stored; call content + CDR stay Signal-E2E and are NOT server-logged. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
